args.code:
def control(obs):
    p=obs['progress']['covered']
    h=obs['hitch_deg']
    if p < 3: desired=5
    elif p < 8: desired=9
    elif p < 13: desired=3
    else: desired=0
    steer=max(-25,min(25,2.0*(h-desired)))
    return (steer,-0.65,170)

    p=obs['progress']['covered']
    h=obs['hitch_deg']
    if p < 3: desired=5
    elif p < 8: desired=9
    elif p < 13: desired=3
    else: desired=0
    steer=max(-25,min(25,2.0*(h-desired)))
    return (steer,-0.65,170)
